caption:
Your "Contact us" page is a dead end.

Someone taps "Contact us" at 21:40. They get a form, a Submit button and "We'll be in touch."
No price. No times. No idea when anyone will reply.

What a contact page can do instead:
→ Show a rough price after a few quick questions
→ Let them book a free roof check in a slot that suits them
→ Offer a message option where a real person replies
→ Say plainly when you reply

Every tap should lead to a next step, not a waiting room.
(The site in this reel is illustrative, not a real installer.)

DM us "AUDIT" for a free, honest website teardown.
